title: We Should Always Be Thinking FORWARD!
cleanTitle: We Should Always Be Thinking FORWARD!
segments: If we are not forwardly thinking,
if we're not looking to move beyond
where we are, we will begin to erode in
the spirit and you're not stagnant,
you're actually going backwards.
Y'all understand me? So, we have to
always move forward. So, in terms of
what I was talking about with the with
the school, I said that we're not going
to be the the Israelites in the
stereotypical Israelite box that not
move. We're going to get the building.
We're going to get the land. We're going
to do this. We're going to keep moving
forward because that's what keeps you
fresh because this is about elevating us
to the next level. It's about elevating
us because we are the jewels of God. We
are the beacons. We are the earth was
made for us.
You dig it? And we have to put that coat
on, so to speak.
We have to put that spirit on. We have
to be what the Lord made us to be.
